scene nightsky
: Uta, where the fuck are we going?
: Just trust me, okay?! I know a spot.
: We already have a spot, though.
: Yes, but this time we’re going to my Io spot.
: I knew you were Io this whole time. From the moment I set foot in the bath house. Don’t think I’ll be deceived by your surprisingly large and clearly fake breasts.
: Fake?! You wound me, Sen- no. Mas- no. Akira!
: That’s the point, U- no. I- no. Uo.
: I’m a fish now?!
I torment her tirelessly. It’s my way of getting back at her for the amount of times she’s blue-balled me so far.
It’s also just fun, though.
Being with her is fun.
And...weirdly different in a way that’s hard to quantify.
Almost natural to a certain extent.
Maybe it’s just because she’s so experienced when it comes to dealing with Io — and that is a girl I have a lot in common with.
But maybe it’s something better. Brighter. Bigger?
Whatever it is, I’m content — for I could stare at the back of her head in every single context for the rest of my life and still believe I’ve done all I was put here to do.
scene black
: Wait, here?
: Mhmmm. Just trust me. Like I said.
Uta slides a lighter out of her pocket. I’m not sure why she has one or what she plans to do with it.
But as we make our way below ground, it begins to become clear.
She leads me to the end of a long tunnel and tells me to sit down.
scene utatunnel1
Which is what brings us here.
: Where are we?
: A secret tunnel. Like in Avatar.
: The James Cameron movie?
: I can’t believe you just said that to me.
: Uta, why do you know about a secret tunnel? And why does it look like people live down here?
: Because they probably do. This thing runs from here all the way to the old district.
: What? Why?
scene utatunnel2
: Ooooh? You don’t know?
: I wouldn’t have asked if I did. I’m not the type to do that just to let someone feel good about knowing stuff.
: Well, Akira — legend has it that when Kumon-mi was first being built, it was only meant to be the old district.
: I assumed as much based on the fact that it is literally called the “old district.”
: Right, because you didn’t let me finish. But what if the new district was actually the older of the two?
: Then the people in charge of city planning here are chaotic and terrible at naming things.
scene utatunnel3
: That’s one possibility, yes. Or...we have a conspiracy on our hands.
: Because I heard that these tunnels were constructed in secret to bridge the gap between the two districts without the true older district ever finding out.
: Mhm. I feel like you might be underestimating how hard it is to build a tunnel of this magnitude in secret.
: Maybe if it was built by conventional means...but what if the old district is actually alive?
scene utatunnel4
: What?
: What if, and hear me out here, the tunnel...built itself? To try and connect to something that already existed! Like a-
: Like a parasite?
scene utatunnel5
: Bingo! When Kumon-mi was first being built, they wanted to create a new type of city that was self-sustainable. But little did they know...it would actually come to life!
scene utatunnel6
: But it was starved for resources and energy! And the ones in charge, desperate to create a brand new type of city, ran out of funding halfway through and had to quit!
scene utatunnel7
: This left the old district scared and desperate...so it sunk its roots into the earth and connected itself to the first thing it found!
scene utatunnel8
: Which brings us here!
scene utatunnel9
: Okay.
: So do you know what this tunnel actually is or should I just pretend to believe all of that?
: Well, let me ask you this — does anybody actually know anything about Kumon-mi?

: Because I couldn’t find like, any info on it at all before I moved here. And all of the stuff I’ve heard about the way it used to be is stuff people heard from people who heard it from...other people.
: I guess it is kind of weird if there’s no...information on that stuff. But the weirdest part of all is just straight up what goes on in the old district.
: Yeah, that place gives me the heebie-jeebies. But that’s further proof that something’s wonky about it, don’t you think?!
: I don’t think we need a full blown conspiracy to land on the fact that that place is creepy, Uta.

: No, we don’t. But the fact that the difference between here and there is so drastic just...I don’t know. I think there’s something weird going on. So I’m going to keep believing the city is alive. Just like our dorm.
: So the dorm is alive too now?
scene utatunnel10
: Well, yeah! It’s gotta be! There are so many floors and we only use three of them. What if all its organs and stuff are in the floors above us and that’s why the other classes haven’t moved in yet?
: Because...the school doesn’t want to...kill a sentient building?
scene utatunnel11
: Yes.
: You’re a bad theorist.
: I just go off vibes.
: Well, can you vibe out an explanation as to why you and Io hang out in a weird tunnel that you think is alive?
scene utatunnel12
: We’ve been coming down here since before we even transferred. Barely do it anymore, though...now that there isn’t really much of a need for it and stuff.
scene utatunnel4
: Io can’t do her hardcore woodworking stuff at her aunt’s house, and our last school wouldn’t let her use the woodshop unsupervised. And me — I just wanted a place to shoot my crossbow.
: So the two of you would sneak into a creepy tunnel that is definitely inhabited by homeless people for the sake of woodworking and archery?
: Yup! That about sums it up.
: And that mattress behind you?
: Idunno. Probably belongs to one of the homeless people.
scene utatunnel13
: We’ve never actually seen anybody down here, though. And the only reason we know it’s connected to the old district is because we overheard some people talking about it at our old school.
: They always said this place was impossible to find, though. Which is weird because me and Io found it after, like...two nights of searching.
: Probably just another urban legend or something. Those are popular in schools nowadays, aren’t they?
: Were they not when you went to school?
: I...can’t remember much about school, to be honest. They might have been?
scene utatunnel14
: Come to think of it, Kumon-mi High doesn’t really have any. At least none that can’t be traced back to stuff Nodoka makes up whenever she gets her crazy eyes.
: She’s not doing that in school now, is she?
scene utatunnel13
: Oh, right. I guess you wouldn’t know unless somebody told you. But yeah — she’s been all sorts of weird ever since the Halloween party. In like a...less Nodoka-ish way, though.
: Which means...what, exactly?
: Well, when she’s not going crazy, she mostly just keeps to herself now. I haven’t even seen her hit on Miss Watabe recently. That was the biggest tip that something was off.
scene utatunnel15
: Is there...anything else you’ve noticed?
: With Nodoka?
: Or anyone. I don’t normally ask Ami about what goes on in school, so...
: Hmm...Kirin’s a little nicer. Chika’s...uhh...odd. And I think Rin might like her again because she’s always staring at her recently.
: Oh, also! I want Noriko and Yumi to make out. Their sexual tension rivals even ours.
: Yumi is straight.
scene utatunnel16
: She can have a curious phase! It happens to all of us. Just...mine happened to last forever. And is only worsened by the fact that everyone in our class is highly kissable.
: But none are more kissable than you, Uta.
scene utatunnel17
: Yet alas — no ring.
: You’re really set on this ring thing, huh?
scene utatunnel18
: Believe it or not, I’m very traditional. I’m just also...highly irresponsible when it comes to...Internet communications.
: So, like...you actually want to wait until marriage?
scene utatunnel19
: I mean...I don’t think it has to be marriage. But I’d definitely want to be dating somebody before anything actually happens, you know?
: So that’s why you’ve so easily avoided my advances this whole time.
scene utatunnel20
: There’s also the fact that none of those “advances” have been real. It’s always just flirting.
: But-
: Jerking off to mini-Uta doesn’t count. That’s not an advance either. But yeah, I’m all talk. I’m sure you’ve figured that out about me by now.
: You’re not all talk if you keep putting yourself in situations like this where we’re all alone. Because the last person who did that with me-
scene utatunnel21
: Bzzt. No talking about other girls when your attention should be on Uta. You’ll make her jealous and cause what few morals she has left to begin blurring.
: You’re one of the most morally good people I know, Uta. You’ve just...done some questionable things out of loneliness in the past. Which isn’t bad. We all break every now and then.
: Yeah...
scene utatunnel22
: In a way, though...me “breaking” brought us closer together.
: Like...if I’d never found out about the picture thing, I don’t know if I’d have ever gotten the courage to tell you how I really feel.
scene utatunnel23
: So being unclean isn’t all bad, right?
: You’re not unclean, Uta.
: No, I’m just fap material for a whole bunch of horny losers all over the globe.
scene utatunnel24
: Akira not included, of course.
scene utatunnel25
: Well, thank you for making an exception to-
: God fucking damn it, it happened again.
: Wait, just now? Seriously?
scene utatunnel26
: Yup! The timing’s so great that I get to worry about my phone being bugged now! Hooray!
: Can’t you, like...turn it into the police or something?
scene utatunnel27
: I do. Or...did. But after doing it a zillion times and nothing coming of it, I just don’t even find it worth it to file the reports anymore.
: This person or...people want to torment me. That much is obvious. All I can really do is just...learn how to deal with it, I guess.
scene utatunnel28
: Still sucks, though. But hey — I wanted attention and now I’m getting it.
: You still shouldn’t have to deal with that.
: Yeah...
: Maybe I should just ditch my phone entirely? Start living more...disconnected.
: You can be like me. Like 50%% of my phone usage is just telling Ami I’m going to be coming home late.
scene utatunnel29
: Or I could lean fully into the virtual world instead and coerce you into connecting as well so we can follow each other and send each other selfies all day.
: I thought you couldn’t send picture messages?
: Not normally. Social media exists, though. Don’t tell my parents.
: I’ve never wanted to join social media more than I do right now.
scene utatunnel26
: I’m very easy to coerce into sending nudes too!
: Uta, come on-
scene utatunnel30
: Do you want to see it?
: What?
scene utatunnel31
: I hold in my hands what could potentially be the holy grail of your spank bank until you finally make your move, Akira.
: You’re...seriously not offering to-
: I told you. It doesn’t bother me when you see them. I like the attention, remember? Don’t you want to see me literally begging for it?
scene utatunnel32
: Don’t you?...
: Yes.
: That’s the problem.
: It’s...not, though.
: Didn’t you personally ask me if I wanted help?
: Is this really your answer to that? Tapping into my biggest weakness? My biggest flaw?
scene utatunnel33
: Oh my god...
scene utatunnel34
: You’re right...you’re so right! What the fuck am I doing?!
: I’m sorry! I...it’s how I...feel better about...my...oh my god.
scene utatunnel35
: AAAAAH! Forget I said that! I...wasn’t thinking! I just...I saw it and my mind went to...aaah! I’m such a fucking whore! I’m such a desperate piece of filthy fucking-
: Uta...stop.
: I wish I could! But I’m a useless piece of shit and I just can’t, Sensei! I can’t take it anymore! I can’t-
: Akira.
scene utatunnel36
: You’re supposed to call me Akira now.
scene utatunnel37
: How are you not disgusted by me?
: I ask myself the same question constantly, just with the roles reversed.
: I’m far more abhorrent than you’ll ever be though, Uta.
: Sniffle.
: What does abhorrent mean?...
: Repugnant.
: Sniffle.
: What does repugnant mean?...
: That I’m disgusting and undesirable and unfit for love.
: Then why am I still so horny?...
scene utatunnel38
: I think you’re just doomed to always feel that way until I become someone worthy of your time.
: There’s no one more worthy of my time than you. I’d take every hand off every clock if it would help you realize that.
: What would you do about the digital ones?
: I don’t know...turn them off, I guess. Sniffle.
: Here, use my sleeve.
: No...sniffle. I have a handkerchief...it’s okay. But thank you...
: Of course.
: So, is this the first time you’ve ever cried in a sewer?
: Heheh...sniffle. No...my bowstring snapped once and hit me in the eye. Io had to make me an eye patch and walk me out of here.
: Then I guess I can be thankful you’re still capable of moving around on your own right now.
: I don’t know, Akira...my body feels really heavy all of a sudden. I think you might have to carry me.
: Uta-
: Ah...sweet death has come to claim poor Uta-chan...
: So horny that...her body...simply could not go on any longer...
: I’ll make sure to mark that down as a note for your gravestone once you get your head out of my lap. You’re on top of my phone.
: Oh, I thought that was something else.
: You thought my penis was rectangular?
: No, I thought it was your wallet.
: Oh.
: What’s this?
: That is my penis.
: Really?...
: No, that’s my wallet.
: Mm! Akiraaaa! Don’t tease Uta-chan! She’s very sensitive right now! That’s- ah!
scene nightsky
I gently stroke her hair as she lays her head in my lap. Her ears are a shade of red so bright that they rival the fire beside us.
: What are you-
: Trying to calm you down. Is it working?
: A little yes...a little no.
: Why not close your eyes then?
: Close my eyes? But what if I fall asleep?
: Well, we’d have two options. I could either put you to bed in that homeless person’s mattress...or I could carry you back to your room like you were begging me to do just a minute ago.
: Okay...can you make me a promise, though?
: What’s that?
: If I invite you inside once we get there...can you say no?
: Uhh...probably not.
: Can you try?...
: You...really want to keep waiting?
: Mhm...
scene black
: I kinda...
: Never want this to end.
: But I also really want you inside of me.
: Welp.
: Oh. That’s gotta be your penis.
: Sure is, Uta. Thanks for just lying on it.
: It’s not a very good pillow. I’m going to adjust. ‘Scuse me!
: I hate you...
And...
Something else I don’t want to say.
$ utaspring4 = True
$ uta_love += 1
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
jump utaspring5
